title: Apple is squirreling away money to pay for lawsuits related to its iPhone 'batterygate' throttling scandal (AAPL)
text: Apple is squirreling away money to pay for lawsuits related to its iPhone 'batterygate' throttling scandal (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Feb 4, 2019, 4:12 pm 29 pts Apple faces government investigations and a class-action lawsuit over a software update that slowed down some iPhone processors. Apple says that the software was designed to improve the user experience and prevent unexpected shutdowns in older phones. Now, Apple has set aside some money to pay to…
